citations.claim: cart approaching track end before violation
first violating step cart outside 2.4m track

explanation: Starting at track edge (x=0.5, v=0.5) with heavy/fast plant (pole_mass 0.2, gravity 12) and dt=0.02, the state-feedback controller applies only ~0.5N (far below 40N limit) prioritizing pole angle (~0.06 rad) while cart drifts with v~1.3-1.37 m/s, crossing |x|=2.4 at step 95. Likely cause: controller gains do not include cart position/track constraint handling, so cart runs off end.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart drifts steadily to the right from steps 92 to 94 while the pole stays nearly upright with its orange tip balanced on top. By step 95 the cart reaches the far right end of the track and runs off the rail.
